artifact.hota.artifacts.goldenGoose.desc:
{Golden Goose}

Counting the effects of its component artifacts, the {Golden Goose} increases its owner's daily income by {5250} gold.

In addition, each allied hero with {Estates} increases the daily income of the player controlling that hero by an additional {3000} gold.

If the bearer of the {Golden Goose} has {Estates}, both bonuses apply simultaneously.

Additional bonuses from further heroes with {Estates} are cumulative.
